title: Restore adjacency-aware band coalescing
description: RibbonPlan stores a ribbon as an ordered list of colored bands. A recent aggregation refactor changed coalesce so separated occurrences of a color lose their positions. Restore the retained ordered-band contract.

requirements.text: coalesce(bands) returns a list of color/length records obtained by replacing each maximal consecutive run of exactly equal color strings with one record whose length is their sum. Preserve run order and label text. Equal colors separated by another color remain separate. An empty input returns [].

bands must be a list of at most 1000 dictionaries, each with exactly color and length keys. color must be a nonempty string; Unicode, case and spaces are literal label content. length must be an integer from 1 through 1000000, excluding booleans. Invalid bands, records, keys or field values raise ValueError, including None, an empty color, and noninteger lengths.

The function must leave the caller's bands list and every contained record unchanged, both on a successful return and when raising ValueError. This includes ordinary nonempty calls whose result differs from the input.
